fact_previews: ThaBIT is a versatile 3D environment written in C++ that serves as a user interface wrapper.
ThaBIT allows interaction with computers in a more natural way, focusing on Internet Browsing, File System Browsing, and interaction with network devices.
ThaBIT is designed to run on ARM, Android, and iOS systems without any problems.
ThaBIT organizes the environment in units known as 'Worlds', which are highly configurable.
Each World in ThaBIT can represent multiple local environments or network devices.

fact_previews: ThaBIT is a project led by Mark Adams.
ThaBIT aims to provide an environment for users to create and share their own plugins.
ThaBIT will not have any central authority or mandatory repository for plugins.
The project emphasizes support for networking, including file sharing among network computers and P2P networking.
ThaBIT is not monetary oriented and is focused on the open-source community.

The team expects to complete basic plugins, with 60% already done, after the Alpha release.
The beta version of ThaBIT could be expected by the end of summer, possibly mid-summer.
